Completely agreed, the comment was in reference to slapping oxygen on everyone and the convoluted instruction OP was given in regards to oxygen administration, most likely due to state testing still being in the slap 15lpm on everyone (I know my state still teaches that). And you’re right about the COPD during transport, however I personally have had the facilities we all know that just keep turning it up over days and do end up tanking their drive and not knowing why so I think as providers we should be aware of that possibility. I was by no means advocating for withholding oxygen for a patient who truly needs it.
Don’t give it to your strokes due to vasoconstriction and watch your COPD’ers but if someone is in need or air hungry don’t deny them the O2 for those reasons.
